gaps.sentence: Please ___ me to post this letter.
gaps.hint: make somebody not forget: ___ somebody to do something
gaps.explanation: 'Remind somebody to do something' means to make someone remember; 'remember' is something you do yourself.

gaps.sentence: Tax is calculated on your total annual ___.
gaps.hint: all the money you receive from every source
gaps.explanation: 'Income' is all the money you receive from work, investments, rent and so on during a period.

gaps.sentence: The bank makes no ___ for using its cash machines.
gaps.hint: money asked for a service; pattern: make a ___ for
gaps.explanation: 'Make a charge for something' means to ask payment for a service; 'tip' is extra money for good service.

gaps.sentence: Please state your ___ on the application form.
gaps.hint: the formal word for your type of work, used on forms
gaps.explanation: 'Occupation' is the formal word for a person's job or profession, typically used on official forms.

gaps.sentence: She has lived in this street ___ 2015.
gaps.hint: starting point of a period up to now
gaps.explanation: 'Since' is used with a point in time when the situation started and continues; 'for' is used with a length of time.

gaps.sentence: She sat ___ me during the whole flight.
gaps.explanation: 'Beside' means next to; 'besides' means in addition to.

gaps.sentence: The sensor is extremely ___ to changes in temperature.
gaps.explanation: 'Sensitive to' reacts readily to something; 'sensible' means showing good judgement.

gaps.sentence: The storm did considerable ___ to the harbour wall.
gaps.explanation: 'Do damage' — uncountable; 'damages' means money awarded in court.
